programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Hearts of Stone
programme.desc: Deadly Women are not always the ones you expect. They are not the strangers lurking in the dark, they are a young mother, a supportive wife and a grandmother - all killers. Behind their loving masquerade lies a wake of family horror and pain.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women burn madly with jealousy, an anger so deep they’ll kill to satisfy it. What makes them turn from “green with envy” to “lethal with jealousy?" Find out as we explore their hearts of darkness.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: In some cases, the transformation from everyday woman to brutal killer is activated by a man. A boyfriend or husband can become the focus of a deadly obsession.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Back in the Hood
programme.desc: Today, Dog's bounty is about to take him on a trip down memory lane and test his investigative chops. With each lead propelling him closer and closer to his childhood haunts, Dog uses old-fashioned detective skills to track his prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: One for the Road
programme.desc: Dog is a big-hearted guy. He's helping Mary Ellen, his friend and fellow bondsman, on a dangerous night hunt for a fugitive she is now regretting bailing out. He's also giving his nephew Justin a second chance to rejoin the team.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bait and Switch
programme.desc: Things are seldom what they seem in the world of bounty hunting. When the fugitive's girlfriend offers to help Dog trap this dangerous felon, Dog knows that someone is being deceived. The only question is, whom?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: True Identity
programme.desc: Dog knows that looks can be deceiving. The fugitive is pretty, petite, and trouble. She stands accused of settling an argument with the help of a box cutter. What Dog does not anticipate is how deceptive this femme fatale can truly be!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: What do you do when you have a fugitive you not only want to find, but believe can be helped back onto the straight and narrow? If you're Mary Ellen you call your good friend Dog.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Match Point
programme.desc: Duty calls and the Chapmans are off on a hunt. The team chases a fugitive who has disappeared into a world of "no known addresses."

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Menehune Mischief
programme.desc: When Beth returns to the compound on the Big Island she finds a damaged SUV and two possible culprits - Dog or Justin. Pressed by Beth, Dog offers a third option. The perpetrators are Hawaii's mythical mischief makers - the Menehune!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mister Mom
programme.desc: It's been quite a while since Tim Chapman put down his mace can and bulletproof vest to care for his growing family. When his old friend Dog calls asking for help tracking an elusive felon, Tim jumps into action.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bait & Snitch
programme.desc: With the aid of the runner's girlfriend the posse heads out to bring a client with a checked past in. Little does the team suspect that before the end of the day Dog will be helping to mend a family torn apart by violence.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Scared Straight
programme.desc: Dog tracks a fugitive who is on the run from the law for the first time. Reading the file Dog knows the young man's life is at the crossroads. Will he be able to track down this wanna-be-gangsta in time to convince him to make the right choice?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All My Children
programme.desc: For a guy who started life as a free spirited outlaw-biker Dog has certainly turned into a family man. His children touch everything he does today, from searching for the perfect gift for his daughter Cecily's birthday to hunting a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: The hunt for an elusive and clever criminal takes Dog through the world of a bantam fighting cock, a pregnant daughter, and a jungle safe house go together. And don't forget the mopeds as well as a group of hostile squatters on government land!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bounty Baby
programme.desc: What's a father to do? When the cops ask Dog for help tracking down a renegade teen with a history of running hard, Baby Lyssa, eight months pregnant and counting, insists on joining the hunt. Can Dog keep his daughter safe and catch his man?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rain Check
programme.desc: For Dog and Beth it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Love on the Run
programme.desc: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date. But he soon learns that she has teamed up with a woman whose criminal exploits have attracted the local media.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Jump Start
programme.desc: Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab. But this commitment to rehabilitation seems to have ended when he bolted from the car on the way to the drug treatment center and went on the run.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Ice Man
programme.desc: Dog's latest fugitive doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of meth when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Trouble in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog is back in Hawaii and tracking a dangerous fugitive through the jungles of the Big Island. Their prey is being protected by a ring of family and friends that Dog must forcefully confront to bring in his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Girl Power
programme.desc: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Dog and his old friends, Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck. When Dog learns that the fugitive is also a disrespectful son, he is more motivated to find his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Ties
programme.desc: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Special Delivery
programme.desc: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of the fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surface Scratches
programme.desc: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Great Debate
programme.desc: When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel.

programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

programme.title: Russ Nagel
programme.desc: Russ has become recognized in the entertainment industry for achieving more laughs per minute than any comedian working the circuit today and has also been seen on The Nashville Network, A&E's Comedy on the Road, Showtime's Comedy Club Network, the WB, Spike TV, Comedy Central and the list goes on and on. Being a 26+ year veteran of the comedy stage, Russ keeps the laughs coming fast and furious with an array of topics ranging from family and marriage, to travel and current events, and yes he even throws in some biker stuff too.

programme.title: Sam Adams
programme.desc: Smooth. Clever. Hilarious. These words are often used to describe Sam Adams as a comedian, public speaker and Master of Ceremonies. In 2001, he stepped on stage to perform stand-up comedy for the first time, at age 41. Eight years later Sam turned to a career in comedy full-time after winning at the Great American Comedy Festival. Sam changed careers after making a name for himself as one of Denver's premier sports journalists. In 2003 was voted by his peers as Colorado's “Print Journalist of the Year.” As a reporter and columnist his work has been featured in The Denver Post, The Charlotte Observer, Rocky Mountain News and Colorado Avid Golfer magazine. Sam has also made numerous TV appearances on ESPN, Fox Sports, CBS, NBC and NFL Network. In 2013, he wrote a book, 'If You Don't Believe Me: Lessons Learned From Listening To The Greats,” giving readers an inside look at his 23-year career as a sports journalist.

programme.title: Jay Whittaker
programme.desc: Jay Whittaker is a comedian, actor, host and writer hailing from Los Angeles & Salt Lake City. He's been seen on the Food Network and even featured in USA Today. He has performed in the Riot L.A. Comedy Festival & the Seattle International Comedy Competition. He's been heard as a panelist on the ever-popular, award-winning Geekshow Podcast and has been seen in several commercials, most notably for McAfee & VSP Direct. His voice can also be heard as a recurring guest on X96 FM's morning show “Radio From Hell”. He can also be seen in the upcoming film “Juarez 2045??. Jay has also won awards for Utah's “Best Comedian”.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: If you're looking for the reason why to use a ladle to eat lucky charms, or why being a Bigfoot hunter is better than being a comedian, your search ends with Brent Terhune, who's "known from time to time, to tell a few jokes.

programme.title: Mary Mack
programme.desc: Folk Humorist Mary Mack performs her sometimes-musical comedy at festivals, colleges, clubs, casinos and anywhere you can find a llama or a buffet line. She has acted in cartoons, weird student films, and commercials that urge you to buy food for your hamster. (Mary is totally FOR feeding your hamster.) A favorite on radio shows and podcasts around the country, including Marc Maron's WTF Podcast, The Bob and Tom Show, and American Public Media's WITS, Mary played the leading character Dylan on Fox's new late night cartoon Golan the Insatiable, season one. Her voice has also been heard in the cult favorite Aqua Teen Hunger Force on Cartoon Network's Adult Swim. Mack's comedy (spotted with occasional mandolin or clarinet outbursts) has been seen in the Vancouver Comedy Fest, The Andy Kaufman Awards, Montreal's Just For Laughs Festival, and the San Francisco Sketch Fest as one of "The Dozen" up and coming headliners designated by the festival. She had her national TV debut on Comedy Central's Live at Gotham and NBC's Last Comic Standing.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E04 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Qatar Cross Country Rally - 2020
programme.desc: Manateq Qatar Cross-Country Rally signaled the opening round of the FIA World Cup for Cross-Country Rallies at the stunning, awe-inspiring state of Qatar. Organised by the Qatar Motor and Motorcycle Federation (QMMF), the event has attracted 33 teams and competitors from 17 nations. Five days of intense competition and 1,444.99 kilometres in the challenging Qatar desert, will test cars and drivers to their limits. Although the event has attracted many teams and competitors, the 3-time Dakar winner Nasser Saleh Al-Attiyah stands out prominently. Al-Attiyah has proven to be a force to be reckoned within the cross-country rally scene. Only just missing the mark in the last Dakar Rally, the born and bred Qatari will be keen to compete and impress on home soil.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany
programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.

programme.title: Part 1

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.

programme.title: The Maya
programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.

programme.title: The Aztecs
programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.

programme.title: The Incas
programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.

programme.title: First Before Columbus
programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!

programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun
programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

programme.title: iCarly: Räuber und Piraten
programme.desc: Zwei Cops haben sich bei Carly und Spencer eingenistet, denn sie haben den dringenden Verdacht, dass im Laden gegenüber Raubkopien von DVDs verkauft werden.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein schickes Angebot
programme.desc: Die Eliteschule Briarwood zieht in Erwägung, Carly ein Stipendium anzubieten. Carly ist sich nicht sicher, ob sie dieses Angebot annehmen soll. Doch Sam und Freddie wissen, sie müssen Carlys Meinung ändern.

programme.title: iCarly: Fechten wir's aus!
programme.desc: Freddie braucht eine Auszeit von den Mädchen. Daher ist er Spencer mehr als dankbar, als er ihn fragt, ob er mit zum Fechten kommen möchte. Allerdings wird es kompliziert, als Spencer ihn gegen den fiesen Doug Toder antreten lässt.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly TV
programme.desc: Der Programmchef eines großen Fernsehsenders ist auf der Suche nach einem neuen Hit und will iCarly zur TV Show machen. Aber Carly und Co. sind bald enttäuscht von den großen Veränderungen, die der Programmchef durchsetzen möchte.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Dreifach-Date
programme.desc: Als ihr Freund Gibby zu schüchtern ist, ein Mädchen, welches er toll findet, um eine Verabredung zu bitten, beschließen Carly und Co. eine Gewinnshow zu machen, bei der er ein Date gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly wird von den iWeb Awards auserwählt, in Japan für den Preis der Besten Comedy anzutreten. Carly, Sam und Freddie proben für den Auftritt einen Extra-Sketch ein und reisen zusammen mit Spencer und Mrs. Benson nach Japan.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 2
programme.desc: Da der Flieger nicht in Japan landet, müssen Carly und Co. mit dem Fallschirm abspringen, um zu den iWeb Awards zu kommen. Alles scheint gut zu gehen, bis sie auf Kyoko und Yuki treffen, die eine gemeinen Plan verfolgen.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 3
programme.desc: Nachdem Kyoko und Yuki Carly und Co. im Nirgendwo ausgesetzt haben, laufen die Drei völlig verzweifelt durch die Gegend. Spencer und Mrs. Benson, die sich befreit haben, versuchen, die Kids zu finden. Schaffen sie es rechtzeitig, Carly zu finden?

programme.title: iCarly: Alle lieben Shane
programme.desc: Als sich Carly und Sam für den gleichen Jungen interessieren, schwören sie sich, ihn nicht zwischen sie kommen zu lassen. Als sich jedoch beide um seine Aufmerksamkeit bemühen, wird ihre Freundschaft auf eine harte Probe gestellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack Rat
programme.desc: Carly muss eingreifen, als sie bemerkt, dass Spencer eine Videospielsucht entwickelt. Währenddessen versucht Sam Freddie davon zu überzeugen, dass er vom Pech verfolgt sein wird, wenn er eine Ketten-Email nicht weiterleitet.

programme.title: iCarly: Raus aus den Schulden
programme.desc: Sam ist beschämt als Freddie und Carly ihr sagen, wieviel Geld sie ihnen bereits schuldig ist. Sam versucht alles, um es ihnen zurückzuzahlen. Sie überlegt sogar, sich einen richtigen Job zu beschaffen.

programme.title: iCarly: Achtung, böser Stiefvater!
programme.desc: Bei iCarly startet mal wieder die Rubrik 'Jetzt zeigen wir's Lewbert'. Dabei wird Lewbert durch eine Explosion verletzt. Die Kids wollen den Protier wieder gesund pflegen. Doch dann springt Mrs. Benson ein und es kommt zu einer kleinen Romanze.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokosnusscremtorte
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. Freddie zu ihrem Lieblingskuchenladen bringen, erfahren sie, dass der Besitzer verstorben ist und auch seine Rezepte eventuell für immer verloren sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gut geküsst ist halb gewonnen
programme.desc: Sam bekommt mit, wie Freddie Carly gesteht, niemals ein Mädchen geküsst zu haben und veröffentlicht dieses Geheimnis auf der Webseite.

programme.title: iCarly: Auto oder Aus
programme.desc: Jeffrey, angeblich Sohn von Autohändler Mr. Flanken, will bei iCarly ein Preisausschreiben starten. Der erste Preis, ein neues Auto, soll von seinem Vater gestiftet werden. Nevel gewinnt den Preis, nur stellt sich die Frage, ob es das Auto wirklich gibt.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie gegen Fred
programme.desc: Freddie bekennt ganz offen seinen Unmut über Freds Popularität im Internet, was den sensiblen Fred dazu bringt, seine Videos nicht länger online zu stellen. Doch jetzt sind die Fans unglücklich!

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Colt für alle Fälle
programme.desc: Carly, Sam und Freddie bekommen die Möglichkeit, mit dem bekannten Kampfsportler Jackson Colt ein Interview zu machen. Und zwar backstage während einer Martial-Arts-Veranstaltung.

programme.title: iCarly: Wurzeln, Beeren und Kompost
programme.desc: Mr. Henning fordert im Naturwissenschaftsunterricht Carly und Co. auf, ein umweltfreundliches Projekt zur Grünen Woche zu entwickeln. Carly baut einen illegalen Atomkraft- Generator.

programme.title: iCarly: Amerika singt
programme.desc: Bei 'Amerika singt' steht das Finale an: David Archuleta gegen Wade Collins. iCarly ruft während der Web-Show dazu auf, für David Archuleta zu stimmen. Das Gewissen nagt an Carly und Co., so dass sie ein Musikvideo für den Verlierer machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam ist ein Mädchen
programme.desc: Sam hat Geburtstag und Carly organisiert für sie eine große Feier. Viele sagen ein paar Worte zu Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly lernt einen richtigen Bad Boy kennen. Sie ist von Griffin zuerst gar nicht begeistert, verliebt sich aber schließlich in ihn, was wiederum Spencer überhaupt nicht gefällt. Carly und Griffin versuchen alles, um sich weiter sehen zu können.

programme.title: iCarly: Hier kommt Missy
programme.desc: Als Carlys alte Freundin Missy aus Seattle zurückzieht, glaubt Sam, Missy wolle sie als Carlys beste Freundin verdrängen. Sam riecht zwar den Braten, aber weder Freddie noch Carly wollen ihr glauben. Ob Missys wahre Absichten dennoch entlarvt werden?

programme.title: iCarly: Gib mir iCarly zurück!
programme.desc: Nevel hat sich die iCarly-URL unter den Nagel gerissen und will sie nur zurückgeben, wenn Carly ihn küsst. Unterdessen hat Spencer versehentlich 200 Kissen bestellt, doch Spencer weiß, wie man aus dieser Situation das Beste macht.

programme.title: iCarly: Spind 239
programme.desc: Sam und Freddie haben bei einem schulinternen Wettbewerb gemeinsam den begehrten Spind 239 gewonnen. Doch das Teilen will nicht so recht klappen. Carly bekommt von Spencer Kunstunterricht.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Die iCarly Awards
programme.desc: Carly und Co. verleihen zehn 'iCarly Awards'. Spencer sollte die Statuen basteln, doch der hat versehentlich eine Riesenstatue gebaut. Um auf die Schnelle zehn Gewinne zusammenzuschustern, holt er sich sechs europäische Bademodenmodels zur Hilfe.

programme.title: iCarly: Die doppelte Sam
programme.desc: Freddie versucht zu beweisen, dass Melanie, Sam's Zwillingsschwester, nur ausgedacht ist. Um Sam zu enttarnen, bittet Freddie Melanie um ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 2
programme.desc: Griffin, ein Junge, der ins Haus gezogen ist, 'borgt' sich Spencers Motorrad, um damit eine Spritztour zu machen. Der Diebstahl fliegt auf und anstatt ihn anzuzeigen, nimmt sich Spencer seiner an und bringt ihm etwas Bildhauerei bei.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Schädel von Charles Dingo
programme.desc: Bei der Show 'Totally Teri' tauchen Showsegmente von iCarly auf. Carly und Co. finden heraus, dass die Autoren der Show die Inhalte geklaut haben. Carly, Sam und Freddie überreden Spencer, sie nach Hollywood zu bringen, um diese Sache aufzuklären.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Kuss
programme.desc: Als Sam versehentlich vor Carly enthüllt, dass sie und Freddie sich heimlich geküsst gehaben, konfrontiert Carly die beiden damit, um herauszufinden, wieso sie ihr das niemals erzählt haben. Unterdessen gibt Spencer Kunstunterricht im Gefängnis.

programme.title: iCarly: Voll auf die Kochmütze!
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. einen bekannten Fernsehkoch in seiner Sendung schlagen, gibt dieser das Kochen auf, bricht seine Show ab und weigert sich, aus dem Schlafzimmer zu kommen. Spencer versucht, seine Vision von der Zukunft Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As preparations are underway for Cully Barnaby's wedding, Ned Fitzroy and Beth Porteous are married in Bledlow village. At the gorgeous reception at Bledlow Hall, the maid of honour, Marina Fellowes, is found by a couple of guests murdered in an upstairs room. With the honeymoon postponed, the newlyweds and their guests find themselves being interrogated by the police.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the name of Tommy Hicks, who was executed for cowardice and desertion during World War I, is added to the war memorial in Midsomer Parva, the Hicks family are very glad. The son and grandson, Lionel and Mayor Dave Hicks, revel in the occasion. The Hammond family are much more displeased. Henry, the patriarch, is infuriated by the move, having sustained a long-running feud with the Hickses.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Dunstan, leads Barnaby and Jones to investigate the deaths of reclusive couple, Ron and Libby Wilson. Early on in the case, they learn that their son Michael had been killed in a hit and run. Not too far away a fiery dispute is in full swing, between a builder who has a very short fuse and a group of road protesters, protesting about plans for a bypass. With hostilities almost at breaking point, it is not long before another death rocks the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Charlie Finleyson is found in woodland in Midsomer Sonning. Barnaby and Jones begin to scrutinise the employees at the offices of Midsomer Life magazine. It is discovered that Mr Finleyson was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the magazine. The detectives also become aware of a dispute between Guy and the owner of the Morecroft Hotel. With tensions starting to rise between the locals and visitors from London.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a children's magic show, a performer assisting with a trick, is poisoned whilst on stage. It is found that the poison came from a species of Ecuadorean frog. Barnaby and Jones discover that conflict is once again brewing between a village occult guide and enthusiast Ernest Baillol and famous writer Aloysius Wilmington who are both searching for a treasured antique book on the subject.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A team building exercise is imminent planned by a new acting Chief Superintendent John Cotton and Barnaby and Jones are very reluctant to take part. Following an explosion in a truck at a haulage yard, both the detectives see the opportunity as a distraction to investigate. It is not long after that a body is discovered, when a trunk resurfaces from the nearby lake. It is identified as Alec Grainger, a man who had been arguing with James Parkes, the son of Colonel Matt Parkes.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Monks Barton, two couples seemingly disappear from their cottages. When Barnaby and Jones arrive and learn of the legendary, mysterious haunted woods, they remain sceptical. Shortly after a body is found in a shallow grave, answering to the description of one of the 'missing'. The detectives have to delve much deeper into the woods and beyond to find out if ghosts are really to blame or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Milton Cross depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton, for their jobs and income. When Sonia Woodley is found murdered in the churchyard, two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, the murder weapon is discovered to be tailor's shears, but which one of villagers is responsible? Barnaby and Jones arrive at Woodley and Woodley, the tailors to find out, to discover that the vicar had received a letter from Sonia a few days before.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a council meeting, Mayor Dave Hicks announces plans to awaken an annual trip to Brighton. Barnaby suspects his proposal to buy coastal land there is a fraud. Barnaby reluctantly joins the party, but during their time in Brighton, hated property developer Hugh Dalgleish is beheaded on a ghost train ride. The detectives together with Tom's cousin DCI John Barnaby gather who from the party or someone else could have been responsible before other murders occur and secrets are uncovered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is anything but quiet, when the Wild West Society bring their show and fair, consisting of many stalls and a shooting re-enactment. The witch on the 'Dunk the Witch' stall, gets truly dunked and goes horribly wrong, when the water starts turning red. Barnaby and Jones have to be alert with a shooter in their midst. With many grudges, jealousies and a dispute over wasteland, known as 'the swamp', as possible motives, it is not long before more people turn up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Joyce Barnaby swerves her car and narrowly misses a shadowy figure in the road. Shortly after a body is found in the local old cemetery. The victim Gerald Ebbs was a member of the council and of the village's library. It is discovered from the villagers that Gerald had had a strange fixation on both the old hospital and cemetery; in particular a grave from within.

programme.title: Barbie a kúzelné dvierka
programme.desc: V tomto čarovnom hudobnom dobrodružstve sa nám Barbie predstaví ako bojazlivá princeznička Alexa, ktorá má radšej spoločnosť svojich obľúbených knižiek než starosti mocnej vládkyne. Pri prechádzke kráľovskou záhradou Alexa z ničoho nič objaví tajné dvere, ktoré sa ako vajce vajcu podobajú tým, o ktorých čítala v jednej knihe! Keď ich otvorí a vstúpi, ocitne sa náhle v podivnom čarovnom svete plnom nadprirodzených bytostí a veľmi prekvapivých javov. Spoznáva tu morskú vílu Rómami a suchozemskú vílu Nori. Od nich sa Alexa dozvie, že Malucia, stelesňujúci vládu zla, sa chce násilím zmocniť všetky čarovné sily tohto kraja. Alex neobyčajne prekvapí zistenie, že v tomto svete je aj ona nadaná kúzelnými silami a jej noví priatelia sú presvedčení, že jedine s Alexinou pomocou sa im môže podariť získať späť ukradnuté čáry máry. Sledujte s nami, čo sa stane, až Alexa zoberie všetku svoju odvahu na obranu toho, čo považuje za správne, a naučí sa, že sila priateľstva ľahko zdolá aj mocnú mágiu.

programme.title: Balto III: Veľké preteky
programme.desc: Balto a jeho syn Kodi si zrazu uvedomia, že technické výdobytky pomaly začínajú ohrozovať aj budúcnosť polárnych psích záprahov, pretože listy a ostatné zásielky sa do mesta Nome dostanú oveľa rýchlejšie lietadlom než na saniach ťahaných psami. Dochádza k ostrému sporu, ktorý má za následok, že sa konajú poštárske preteky medzi zástancami tradičných saní vedenými Baltom a pilotom menom Duke, ktorého lietadlo Balta veľmi očarilo. Duke do cieľa vôbec nedorazí, a tak sa niekoľko psov začne radovať a jasať, že sa im tak dokonale podarilo dokázať prevahu psieho záprahu, ale Balto tuší, že sa stalo nejaké veľké nešťastie. Preto Balto s pomocou Muka a Luka beží Dukovi a Borisovi na pomoc a snaží sa nájsť zrútené lietadlo. Na tejto ceste, blahodarne pôsobiace na ich duši, môžete záchranca sprevádzať aj vy.

programme.title: Barbie v Luskáčikovi
programme.desc: Barbie tentoraz vďaka neprekonateľnej počítačovej animácii ožije v tejto prekrásnej modernej verzii klasickej rozprávky E. T. A. Hoffmanna v naozaj úžasnéj forme. Rozprávka začína tým, že Barbie, ktorá hrá úlohu Kláry, dostane od svojej najmilšie tety krásnu drevenú bábku - je to luskáčik na orechy - avšak Luskáčik sa ešte tej istej noci, zatiaľ čo Klára spí, stane živým princom, aby dievča ochránil pred zlým Myším kráľom, ktorý prenikol ku Kláre do izby. Dievčatko sa prebudí a Luskáčikovi pomôže, ale Myší kráľ zlým čarom Kláru zmenší. Preto sa musí s Luskáčikom vydať na dobrodružnú cestu, aby našli kňažnú Bonbón, jedine ona totiž dokáže zlomiť zlé čiary myšieho kráľa. Krásu príbehu umocňujú strhujúce tanečné scény, ktoré na príjemnú Čajkovského hudbu vymyslel a nacvičil slávny choreograf Peter Martins. Skutočné pohyby členov Newyorským mestského baletu predvádzajú krásu baletu na televíznej obrazovke spôsobom, ktorý bol doteraz nepredstaviteľný. Barbie v Luskáčikovi divákom...

programme.title: Barbie a dvanásť tancujúcich princezien
programme.desc: Kde bolo tam bolo, hudba plnila zámok kde žilo nie jedna, nie dve, ale dvanásť princezien so svojím milovaným ockom, kráľom. Od najstarších po najmladších, všetkých dvanásť princezien milovalo tanec. Najpôvabnejšou tanečnicou zo všetkých bola siedma princezná, Barbie. Kráľ, premožený výchovou dvanástich energických dcér požiadal o pomoc svoju sesternicu, Rowenu. Chamtivá Rowena rýchlo vyženie radosť z hradu v prestrojení za snahu vychovať z princezien "dokonalé princezné". Už žiadny tanec. Žiadna hudba. Žiadna zábava. Princezné sú z toho nešťastné, až do doby kedy sa Barbie podarí objaviť tajný vchod do magického sveta cez portál v ich spálni. Princezné v ňom nájdu krásny pavilón v krajine zlatých a strieborných stromov. Čarovný prach zo stromov premení ich nočné košele v baletné šaty. V tomto svete môžu konečne princezné robiť to čo najviac milujú... tancovať. Vracajú sa na toto miesto každú noc, tancujúce až do chvíle kedy pretancujú svoje črievice. Každú noc sú znovu a znovu...

programme.title: Barbie a dvanásť tancujúcich princezien
programme.desc: Kde bolo tam bolo, hudba plnila zámok kde žilo nie jedna, nie dve, ale dvanásť princezien so svojím milovaným ockom, kráľom. Od najstarších po najmladších, všetkých dvanásť princezien milovalo tanec. Najpôvabnejšou tanečnicou zo všetkých bola siedma princezná, Barbie. Kráľ, premožený výchovou dvanástich energických dcér požiadal o pomoc svoju sesternicu, Rowenu. Chamtivá Rowena rýchlo vyženie radosť z hradu v prestrojení za snahu vychovať z princezien "dokonalé princezné". Už žiadny tanec. Žiadna hudba. Žiadna zábava. Princezné sú z toho nešťastné, až do doby kedy sa Barbie podarí objaviť tajný vchod do magického sveta cez portál v ich spálni. Princezné v ňom nájdu krásny pavilón v krajine zlatých a strieborných stromov. Čarovný prach zo stromov premení ich nočné košele v baletné šaty. V tomto svete môžu konečne princezné robiť to čo najviac milujú... tancovať. Vracajú sa na toto miesto každú noc, tancujúce až do chvíle kedy pretancujú svoje črievice. Každú noc sú znovu a znovu...

programme.title: Barbie a kúzelné dvierka
programme.desc: V tomto čarovnom hudobnom dobrodružstve sa nám Barbie predstaví ako bojazlivá princeznička Alexa, ktorá má radšej spoločnosť svojich obľúbených knižiek než starosti mocnej vládkyne. Pri prechádzke kráľovskou záhradou Alexa z ničoho nič objaví tajné dvere, ktoré sa ako vajce vajcu podobajú tým, o ktorých čítala v jednej knihe! Keď ich otvorí a vstúpi, ocitne sa náhle v podivnom čarovnom svete plnom nadprirodzených bytostí a veľmi prekvapivých javov. Spoznáva tu morskú vílu Rómami a suchozemskú vílu Nori. Od nich sa Alexa dozvie, že Malucia, stelesňujúci vládu zla, sa chce násilím zmocniť všetky čarovné sily tohto kraja. Alex neobyčajne prekvapí zistenie, že v tomto svete je aj ona nadaná kúzelnými silami a jej noví priatelia sú presvedčení, že jedine s Alexinou pomocou sa im môže podariť získať späť ukradnuté čáry máry. Sledujte s nami, čo sa stane, až Alexa zoberie všetku svoju odvahu na obranu toho, čo považuje za správne, a naučí sa, že sila priateľstva ľahko zdolá aj mocnú mágiu.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Amnesiac
programme.desc: As a doctor with a startling new treatment for amnesia, Jim Phelps forces Paris to relive another man's past when the IMF pushes a search for stolen nuclear material on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 1)
programme.desc: Guest stars Noel Harrison and Diane Baker are drawn into a daring IMF charade that uses a trained falcon to help in a crown jewel theft in the first of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 2)
programme.desc: Barney is blinded in an accident, a bride-to-be is buried alive and Paris poses as a man he is unaware is marked for death in the second of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 3)
programme.desc: A trained falcon is summoned in a last-ditch rescue attempt when Jim Phelps finds his IMF endangered by a traitor's assassination plot in the last of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Chico
programme.desc: A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Gitano
programme.desc: The IMF hides a young prince from assassins by disguising him as a gypsy girl, then Paris sets out to betray the boy to his pursuers on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Phantoms
programme.desc: To fight an aging dictator's purge of young artists, an IMF member (guest star Antoinette Bower) becomes a ghost and Paris assumes the guise of a man long dead on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Terror
programme.desc: To calm a Middle East trouble spot, the IMF tries to keep a man in prison long enough to make it look as though he is trying to break out on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Lover's Knot
programme.desc: In the midst of delicate operations to identify the chief of an espionage ring, Jim Phelps realizes that Paris has fallen in love with an enemy agent on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Orpheus
programme.desc: Jim Phelps assumes a risky pose as a drug addict with information to sell to get behind the Iron Curtain where he seeks to stop an unknown assassin from killing an unknown victim on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Crane
programme.desc: After rescuing a prisoner from execution by a dictator (guest star Carl Betz), the IMF has to find a hiding place so conspicuous it will be overlooked by police hunting the fugitive on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Death Squad
programme.desc: Jim Phelps leads the IMF to aid one of its own members when Barney is arrested and marked for execution by a sadistic police chief (guest star Pernell Roberts) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Choice
programme.desc: Paris is marked for execution when he impersonates a power-mad mystic trying to win control of a friendly country by hypnotizing its woman ruler on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Martyr
programme.desc: To keep a student congress from being used as a rubber stamp by a repressive premier (John Larch), the IMF sets Phelps up for capture so he can betray Paris as a turncoat student leader on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: ММА Серия – 89: Elite Fights. Д.Гонсалвес vs С.Бобрышев
Клетка Виктории Ицеховской (MMA Серия – 89: Elite Fights)
programme.desc: В этой программе ведущая покажет вам изнутри весь масштаб и энергетику турнира по ММА. Она проведет вас за кулисы, где кипят страсти, и раскроет все тайны подготовки бойцов перед выходом на ринг. Ожесточенные тренировки, напряженные моменты ожидания и, конечно же, жаркие схватки – все это вы увидите своими глазами

programme.title: MMA Series Names (С.Бурастов)
programme.desc: Мы представим вам серию специальных выпусков, посвященных самым ярким личностям и культовым моментам в истории MMA. Вы познакомитесь с легендарными бойцами, услышите их вдохновляющие истории борьбы и побед, а также увидите эксклюзивные кадры тренировок и интервью. Не упустите шанс окунуться в атмосферу настоящего спорта и узнать больше о тех, кто сделал MMA таким популярным!

programme.title: MMA Series Classic. Б.Гуськов, С.Бобрышев, В.Уокер
MMA Series Main Card
programme.desc: Зрителей ждет насыщенная программа с участием сильнейших спортсменов, которые готовы сразиться за победу в зрелищных поединках. programme.title: Paranormal State: Night Terrors

programme.title: Paranormal State: Devil's Hostage

programme.title: Paranormal State: Return of the Dead: Glove II

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Ladder

programme.title: Paranormal State: Pet Cemetery
programme.desc: Ryan and his team investigate the bizarre haunting of a woman and her dog in Waterboro, Maine. The Labrador was chewing at her own fur and standing on guard on the bed, growling at unseen figures.

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny kaster aldrig et blik på sin kedelige, men loyale assistent Claire . Men da han opdager, at hun er en usleben diamant, beslutter han sig for at forvandle hende til en skønhed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: Da Robert får at vide, at hans bror er omkommet i en bådulykke, tager han af sted for at hente liget og møder Evie Shaw. Han bliver besat af sin brors mistænkelige død... og af Evie. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirmaet Carly Westin indvilliger i at tilberede et festmåltid for en veninde. Men parret bliver myrdet, mens hun er i køkkenet. Da politiefterforsker Jack bliver involveret, må han beskytte Carly. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: Da den urolige tvilling Dominique beder sin boglige søster Kimberly om at overtage hendes rolle som glamourøs parisisk model i en måned, tøver Kimberly. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa vågner op på hospitalet, kan hun ikke huske noget: Hun kan ikke huske, hvem hun er, at hendes mand ønsker at lade sig skilles. Da hendes mand tager hende med hjem, må Lisa lære alting forfra. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne mistænker, at hendes bror Alans død ikke var et uheld, og beslutter sig for at undersøge sagen. Hun begynder at arbejde for den magtfulde familie, der muligvis har haft en finger med i spillet. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En forældreløs piges (Mel Harris) søgen efter sin fortid begynder med et barndomsfoto af hende selv ved siden af en sjælden spilledåse og fører hende til en forførende skattejæger. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Kom så Diego!

programme.title: Kom så Diego!

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Åh, nej! Dora har glemt hendes musikopgave på Boots' værelse. Det er en sang på dansk og engelsk, og hun har brug for, at Boots afleverer den på hendes skole, så hun kan synge den for klassen.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Dora's lillebror og lillesøster elsker bananer, men de elsker også historier. Så Dora fortæller dem en historie om Super-babyer. Super-baby´erne skal skaffe bananerne tilbage fra ræven Huggo.

programme.title: Kom så Diego!
programme.desc: Diego er ude for at udforske vulkaner, da Alicia pludselig kontakter ham på hans Video-ur, og fortæller ham, at undervandsvulkanerne er ved at gå i udbrud!

programme.title: Kom så Diego!
programme.desc: Leguansangen skal til at starte, men en af leguanerne mangler, Leguanen Iggy er forsvundet i en kold hule, og leguaner kan ikke bevæge sig i kulde.

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinerne
programme.desc: Da Crusher forsøger at få Blazer-fart for sig selv, sender han ved et uheld Blazes maskine ud at flyve. Nu er det Blaze mod Crusher i et kapløb om Blazer-fart, men uden en maskine må Blaze finde andre måder at nå frem til sejr på.

programme.title: Top Wing

programme.title: Top Wing

programme.desc: Top Wing optræner nogle venner til at blive "juniorkadetter". Da Flager vil bevise, at han kan være en redningshelt, må kadetterne redde Flager. // Kadetterne finder et skattekort. Da Flager stjæler det, opstår et kapløb om at finde skatten.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Dora og alle hendes venner deltager i super eventyr løbet. For at vinde konkurrencen, skal de nå frem til mållinien.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Der er "Kryb-og-kravl-parade", og Bubble Guppies marcherer med myrerne og summer med bierne! Der er så meget forskelligt kryb og kravl, og hver Guppy har sin egen favorit. Men det edderkoppen Charlie, der får et særligt venskab med Gil og Molly.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Velkommen til Bubbletuckys Store Flyvestævne! I dag skal Bubble Guppies se rigtig mange fugle på vingerne! Men da en flyvende andefamilie bliver væk i en tordensky, er det op til Molly, Gil og Beep at flyve ind og redde dem!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Kan du høre togfløjten? Det er Gamle Nummer Ni, et gammelt damplokomotiv, der kommer kørende. Hun er med i Tre-togsterrænløbet! Man da en flok køer forvilder sig ud på skinnerne, ser det ikke godt ud for Gamle Nummer Ni.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets

programme.desc: Botterne får en virus og spreder kaos med deres voldsomme nys. Børnene må finde en kur og sætte en stopper for postyret. // Bytes graver sig ned i en mine, og nu er det op til, Rusty, Ronja og Robotosaurus at finde ham og derefter grave sig ud.

programme.desc: Fredrik vil gerne være helt som Rusty, så han skaber en Balladebot, der skal få Fredrik til at tage sig ud som helt. // Et rumvæsen nødlander på Jorden, og Rusty og Ronja må hjælpe det med at komme hjem til årets vigtigste rumvæsenhøjtid.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.desc: Dora og Boots morer sig på stranden, da de pludselig hører et råb om hjælp. Det er en krabbeunge, som sidder fast i et net.

programme.desc: Fran und Judi treffen im Kino auf Peter und seinen Freund Chris, von dem Fran nichts wusste. Peter erklärt ihr warum er das verheimlicht hat. Chris lebt ebenfalls noch bei seinem Ex-Freund.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Peggy
programme.desc: Peters Schwester Peggy kommt überraschend zu Besuch. Fran hat ihr bis heute nicht vergeben, dass Peggy auf Frans und Peters Hochzeit einen Einwand hatte. Die Situation eskaliert, als sich Peggy in die Hochzeitsplanungen einmischt.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Plötzlich Eltern
programme.desc: Fran und Peter sollen auf Cesars Sohn und Neils Tochter aufpassen, doch die beiden verschwinden. Fran und Peter finden die beiden 16-Jährigen sich küssend in Neils Whirlpool.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Der Feind in meinen Träumen
programme.desc: Als Fran ihrem Nachbarn Neil das Leben rettet, hofft sie, dass er ihre Schulden vergisst. Nachdem dieser über dieses Verhalten wütend wird, bekommt Fran erotische Träume von Neil.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Überraschung mit Folgen
programme.desc: Kurz nachdem Fran von ihrem Nachbarn Neil geküsst wurde, überrascht sie ihren Verlobten Elliot in London. Doch auch er hat eine unangenehme Überraschung für sie.

programme.title: The Exes: Der Einzug
programme.desc: Der kürzlich geschiedene Stuart braucht eine neue Wohnung, also stellt seine Scheidungsanwältin Holly ihm ihre anderen geschiedenen Klienten vor: Phil und Haskell. Stuart zieht zu ihnen in die Wohnung gegenüber von Holly.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Uhren-Kollektion
programme.desc: Phil will einen Freund mit der klein geratenen Eden verkuppeln. Dieser möchte jedoch unbedingt ein Date mit Holly. Währenddessen hilft Haskwell Stuarts Uhren-Kollektion im Internet zu verkaufen.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Kreuzfahrt
programme.desc: Holly verschafft Stuart ein Date mit Katy ohne zu wissen, dass sie ein Call-Girl ist. Derweil versucht Haskell seine Ex-Frau davon zu überzeugen, dass er auf einer Kreuzfahrt ist.

programme.title: The Exes: Der Obdachlose
programme.desc: Haskell möchte, dass statt ihm Phil seine Internet-Freundin Rebecca trifft. Holly verguckt sich in einen Obdachlosen, der im Gebäude seine Wäsche gewaschen hat.

programme.title: The Exes: Der Servietten-Falter
programme.desc: Phil hat Angst vorm Zahnarzt und traut auch Stuart nicht zu seinen Zahn zu behandeln. Doch bei Stuart in der Praxis fühlt er sich so wohl, dass er mit seiner Assistentin Deanna schläft. Eden borgt sich Klamotten von Holly.

programme.title: The Exes: Mutter zu Besuch
programme.desc: Holly muss ihrer Mutter gestehen, dass sie ihre Verlobung gelöst hat, als Marjorie zu Besuch kommt. Doch die Wahrheit ist ihr unangenehm. Also lässt sich Holly etwas einfallen um das Geständnis heraus zu zögern.

programme.title: The Exes: Dates mit gewissen Schwierigkeiten
programme.desc: Phil braucht einen Übersetzer für sein Date mit einem serbischen Unterwäschemodel. Stuart springt ein, doch dann verguckt sich Tatiana in ihn. Holly macht sich vor ihrem Schwarm peinlich und Haskell kauft sich einen Sarg.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Ex-Frau
programme.desc: Phil ist super drauf: Seine Ex heiratet wieder und das bedeutet, dass er keinen Unterhalt mehr zahlen muss. Doch als er ihren Verlobten beim Fremdgehen erwischt, plagt ihn sein Gewissen. Holly flirtet mit einem Kollegen.

programme.title: The Exes: Rückenbeschwerden
programme.desc: Holly trifft sich mit Kevin Tyler, einem Basketballspieler und Phils Klient. Alles läuft gut, doch ihr Verhältnis droht seine spielerische Leistung zu beeinträchtigen. Haskell und Stuart finden Gefallen an Sportwetten.

programme.title: The Exes: Wenn der Ex-Mann zweimal klingelt
programme.desc: Holly will ihren Ex-Verlobten Brad eifersüchtig machen und will, dass einer der Jungs ihren neuen Freund mimt. Doch alle drei stellen sich ein und Hollys Geschichte wird immer unglaubwürdiger...

programme.title: The Exes: Familienberatung
programme.desc: Holly schickt ihre Jungs zu einer Therapeutin, da es in ihrer WG nicht so toll läuft. Doch da stellt es sich heraus, dass SIE das eigentliche Problem ist.

programme.title: The Exes: Was Frauen wirklich wollen
programme.desc: Holly sieht Stuart aus Versehen nackt. Er hinterlässt einen "großen" Eindruck. Das verändert erheblich wie Holly und die anderen Männer ihn wahrnehmen.

programme.title: The Exes: Haskells geschicktes Händchen
programme.desc: Holly und Haskell üben aneinander das Daten. Stuart versucht etwas zu sehr sich in Phils Freundeskreis zu integrieren.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Affäre
programme.desc: Stuarts ehemaliger Hund Chopin darf bei ihm übernachten. Doch Phil hat einen One-Night-Stand mit einer Hundehälterin, deren Vierbeiner Chopin zum Verwechseln ähnlich ist. Holly vermutet, dass Eden eine Affäre mit dem Chef hat.

programme.title: The Exes: Schwere Geschütze
programme.desc: Stuart landet nach einer Stippvisite im Striplokal im Krankenhaus, wo Phil einen Klienten unter Vertrag nehmen wollte. Eden kauft Holly einen neuen BH.

programme.title: The Exes: Darf ich bitten
programme.desc: Stuart will seine Ex-Frau Lorna bei einem Tanzwettbewerb beeindrucken. Doch Holly ist dabei keine große Hilfe. Zudem sind Lorna und ihr Tanzpartner die Favoriten. Phil trifft auf Kendra, eine ebenbürtige Gegenspielerin.

programme.title: The Exes: Drei Männer und ein Babywunsch
programme.desc: Holly hört auf einmal ihre biologische Uhr ticken. Phil, Stuart, Haskell und Eden müssen ihr helfen einen geeigneten Samenspender zu finden.

programme.title: The Exes: Holly hat ihren Groove zurück
programme.desc: Holly schwärmt für einen Kollegen und ist neugierig, wie er über sie denkt. Stuart engagiert eine Putzfrau weil er keine Lust mehr hat, alles selbst zu erledigen - doch damit bringt er Haskells Leben völlig durcheinander.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Party
programme.desc: Hollys neuer Freund Paul lädt die Jungs auf eine tolle Party ein. Stuart beginnt sich zu fragen, wie eng Paul noch mit seiner Ex-Frau verbunden ist.

programme.title: The Exes: Schwesternliebe
programme.desc: Holly will ihre unfehlbare Schwester mit einer neuen Identität zu beeindrucken - doch der Plan geht schief. Die Jungs sind begeistert von Stuarts Kochkünsten.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Tennisstunde
programme.desc: Eden ist im neunten Monat schwanger und macht Holly das Leben zur Hölle. Ständig passt ihr irgendetwas nicht oder sie hat Gelüste nach etwas Besonderem. Phil steht kurz davor, einen Mega-Werbedeal für einen seiner Klienten an Land zu ziehen.

programme.desc: Was ist wirklich dran am Traum von sekundenschneller Reise durch Raum und Zeit? Prof. Dr. Ulrich Walter nimmt uns mit auf eine Expedition ins All und erklärt die Phänomene des Universums.

programme.title: Die Entdeckung des blauen Planeten

programme.sub-title: Der schwerelose Mensch - Leben und Lieben im All
programme.desc: Seit vierzig Jahren leben Menschen im Weltraum - zuerst auf den Raumstationen Saljut und Skylab, heute auf der ISS, und vielleicht schon bald in einem Raumschiff auf dem Weg zum Mars.

programme.title: Spacetime: Arbeitsplatz Unendlichkeit - Wie wird man Astronaut?
programme.sub-title: Arbeitsplatz Unendlichkeit - Wie wird man Astronaut?
programme.desc: Die Erde einmal aus dem All zu betrachten - wer wünscht sich das nicht? Aber ist Astronaut zu sein wirklich ein Traumberuf? Lohnen sich die Strapazen der jahrelangen Ausbildung?

programme.title: Spacetime: Rückkehr zum Mond! - Der Wettlauf beginnt
programme.sub-title: Rückkehr zum Mond! - Der Wettlauf beginnt
programme.desc: 1969 setzte Neil Armstrong den ersten Schritt auf die Mondoberfläche. Nur elf weitere Männer folgten ihm bis 1972. Danach wurde es ruhiger um den Erdtrabanten.

programme.sub-title: Planeten - Die Suche nach einer neuen Welt

programme.title: Spacetime: Für die Erde ins All - Wie Satelliten unser Leben verändern
programme.sub-title: Für die Erde ins All - Wie Satelliten unser Leben verändern
programme.desc: 2015 wird Nepal vom stärksten Erdbeben der Landesgeschichte erschüttert. Bilder von Radarsatelliten kennzeichnen die geologischen Folgen des Bebens - fast zentimetergenau.

programme.title: Spacetime: Europa im All - Raumfahrt ohne Grenzen
programme.sub-title: Europa im All - Raumfahrt ohne Grenzen
programme.desc: Mit nur einem Fehlstart bei über 60 Flügen ist die Ariane 5 die zuverlässigste Trägerrakete der Welt. Europa ist vor den USA und Russland Weltmarktführer für kommerzielle Satellitenstarts.

programme.sub-title: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A playwright makes characters come to life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Jess-Belle enlists the aid of a local witch who casts a spell that makes Billy-Ben fall in love with her.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Awakened by the cries of their daughter Bettina, Chris and Ruth Miller enter her room to find that she has vanished - even though they still hear her crying for help. Chris' physicist friend Bill thinks she moved into another dimension.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A scientist creates an android that has the qualities which he feels he's lacking.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programme.title: Panic Room
programme.desc: When her home is invaded by three armed robbers, a divorced woman and her young daughter hide in their specially designed panic room, but end up in a deadly cat-and-mouse game anyway.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

programme.title: Trading Paint
programme.desc: A down-and-out stock car racing legend (John Travolta) is drawn back to the dirt track when his son (Toby Sebastian), an aspiring driver, joins a rival racing team, which sparks an intense and dangerous competition between father and son.

programme.title: Blue Ruin
programme.desc: BLUE RUIN is a classic American revenge story, following a mysterious outsider whose quiet life is turned upside down when he returns to his childhood home, determined to carry out an act of vengeance.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut)
programme.desc: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

programme.title: End Of Watch
programme.desc: Officers Brian Taylor (Jake Gyllenhaal) and Mike Zavala (Michael Peña) form a powerful brotherhood to ensure they both go home at the end of their shifts in South Central, Los Angeles.

programme.title: Timber Kings: The Boss Can Build
programme.desc: André the GM and master salesman must go to Ontario and lead his first build in more than 10 years, Beat has to collaborate in carving a hairy friend.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Giddy Up
programme.desc: Beat saddles up for Germany and the creation of a western-style guesthouse to match the saloon he built for his cowboy-loving clients.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Jolly Ole Island
programme.desc: Joel assembles a millionaire’s retreat on a private island in England, Beat gets an emotional assignment, and Peter cannot take a vacation until he completes an HQ remodel for The Chief’s return.

programme.title: Timber Kings: All Shook Up
programme.desc: Joel builds an earthquake-proof home on Vancouver Island. Meanwhile Andre travels to Kamloops, BC to construct a modern timber-frame home for his nephew. Peter and Beat see who can create the quickest Soapbox Derby cart.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Cliffside Castle
programme.desc: Beat takes on one of the most perilous builds of his career, a luxury twin-turreted vacation home on the edge of 100-foot cliff.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Where There’s Smoke
programme.desc: The heat is on Bryan Jr. to build a deluxe, log smoker for the family fishing resort. Meanwhile, Beat constructs the ultimate summer home in Ontario's lush countryside.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Coming Home
programme.desc: In Alberta, Beat is tasked with building one man’s dream home on the picturesque farmland where he grew up.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Heaven’s Gate
programme.desc: Bryan Jr. feels the heat to recreate the cozy log home a British Columbia couple lost to a fire. Meanwhile, Peter hopes for a ticket to heaven by building a covered entrway for the local church.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Timber Kings: Behind the Sawdust
programme.desc: Timber Kings: Behind the Sawdust captures the world’s best log home craftsmen like never before! This one-hour special takes you behind the scenes.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Active Duty
programme.desc: In California, Joel is under the gun, with a job that’s behind schedule before it even begins. Meanwhile, Beat marshals the troops to finish a mega project on the verge of shipping out.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Going for Gold
programme.desc: Joel takes on the mother of all builds – a 20,000-sq./ft. Pennsylvania mansion complete with walk through tree, hand-carved totem pole and 3-story spiral log staircase.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Planes, Cranes and Automobiles
programme.desc: Beat takes on his biggest build this season, a 15,000 square foot mansion with logs so massive they tax the crane and crew to the limits.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Cowboy Confidential
programme.desc: Beat and Andre are lassoed into building an elaborate carved archway for the Williams Lake Stampede. Meanwhile, Joel wrangles a rookie crew to construct a vacation home in the wilds of Wisconsin.

programme.title: Timber Kings: Weather or Not
programme.desc: Peter battles the elements to build a retirement home for childhood sweethearts, while Bryan Jr. constructs an entryway for his own sweetheart - wife Tabby.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.sub-title: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.sub-title: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees

programme.title: La Carretera
programme.desc: Film basado en la espléndida novela de Cormac McCarthy que ganó el premio Pulitzer en 2007. La película nos introduce en un mundo apocalíptico, arrasado por una explosión nuclear, en el cual un padre y su hijo viajan hacia la costa para buscar un lugar seguro donde vivir. Durante su viaje se encontrarán con los pocos seres humanos que quedan.

programme.title: Mis Dos Amores
programme.desc: Leonard (Joaquin Phoenix), un soltero que ha regresado al piso de sus padres en Brooklyn, empieza a salir con Sandra (Vinessa Shaw), una joven encantadora con la que el matrimonio parece cercano. Pero aparece en su vida una nueva vecina, Michelle (Gwyneth Paltrow), tan bella como voluble, de la que se enamora locamente, lo que no hace sino empezar a complicar la tranquila vida que se le planteaba… Festival de Cannes 2008, Nominada a la Palma de Oro. Premios César 2009, Nominada la Mejor Película Extranjera. Premio Sant Jordi 2011 al Mejor Actor Extranjero (Joaquin Phoenix).

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director después de los magníficos guiones de Amores perros, 21 gramos y Babel. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor, las relaciones clandestinas, los accidentes y la muerte que se cruzan entre sí.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película narra la historia de amistad entre un profesor universitario (encarnado por Richard Gere) y Hachi, el perro de raza Akita que recoge perdido en una estación.

Temiendo por la seguridad de su esposa, rompe la cuarentena y se adentra en un mundo devastado, lleno de infectados monstruosos y perseguido por una agencia sospechosa.

programme.title: La posesión de Emma Evans
programme.desc: Harta de un ambiente familiar que considera excesivamente asfixiante y autoritario, Emma Evans, una adolescente problemática e insatisfecha, decide liberarse de esa atmófera opresiva. Para conseguirlo, da rienda suelta a sus deseos más ocultos, sin sospechar que desencadenará oscuras y poderosas fuerzas que no podrá controlar y que traerán el horror y la tragedia al hogar de los Evans.

programme.desc: Un ejecutivo cincuentón y venido a menos intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo (y cosas como acostarse con la hija de su nueva esposa) han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: La noche del viernes es casi como una Nochevieja acortada, en la que cabe esperar todo tipo de sorpresas... La noche del viernes tiene una magia especial...

programme.title: ¿Qué les pasó a las abejas?
programme.desc: Después de que millones de abejas murieran en una zona maya de México, las comunidades apicultoras se organizaron para detectar la causa y enfrentar a las autoridades.

programme.title: Socorro, He Encogadio a mi Profe!
programme.desc: Félix, un niño de once años, encoge accidentalmente a la odiosa directora de su colegio hasta reducirla al tamaño de un lápiz.

programme.title: Cortes Peligrosos
programme.desc: Una comedia negra ambientada en una peluquería de clase trabajadora de Dublín donde las estilistas se convierten en justicieras accidentales y héroes de la comunidad.

programme.title: La mujer del infierno
programme.desc: Película pre-candidata a los Oscar 2021. Maya, una mujer sin pasado ni familia, recibe una carta que le informa que ha heredado una casa ancestral en una aldea rural. Al llegar, descubre una comunidad violenta que la ha buscado durante años, culpándola de ser el origen de una maldición que los ha atormentado por generaciones.

programme.title: Summer Camp
programme.desc: En busca de diversión y nuevas experiencias, cuatro jóvenes se apuntan como monitores de campamento. Comienza entonces un implacable juego del gato y el ratón, en el que ambos son cazadores e intercambian sus papeles para ser cazados. Para sobrevivir, sólo les queda una opción: encontrar el origen de la infección que les permita poner fin a la terrible pesadilla.

programme.title: Los Hijos de Allen Funt
programme.desc: Entre las paredes de una habitación blanca, cinco personas viven confinadas. A diario, son obligadas a participar en una votación que permitirá al ganador lograr la recompensa prometida de salir al exterior. Uno de ellos tendrá la oportunidad de conseguirlo.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de “Paris, je t’aime” (2006), doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como plató y narran diferentes historias de amor en esta película coral.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Un reconocido chef de Londres disfruta del éxito profesional hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo y abrir un pequeño restaurante en el campo. Así conocerá a Kate, una crítica gastronómica, que le ayudará a creer nuevamente en el amor.
